softwareInnerHero.title: Professional Design with AutoCAD
paragraphs: In today’s competitive preconstruction landscape, accurate and efficient quantity takeoff is essential.

Autodesk Takeoff Solutions empower estimating teams to streamline bid preparation, improve accuracy, and accelerate the estimation process. Whether performing linear, count, or area measurements on 2D drawings or extracting quantities from complex 3D BIM models, this cloud-based software enhances how project scope is measured, visualized, and managed.
With unified 2D and 3D quantification, customizable formulas, centralized quantity tracking, and seamless data aggregation, teams gain superior estimation efficiency.

Features like automated 3D model quantity extraction, machine learning-based symbol detection, real-time version control, and direct Excel export ensure every estimate is precise, competitive, and reliable, optimizing project planning and preconstruction workflows.
